name: barber
description: EXPERIMENTAL. Query-aware trimming of tool output before it enters context, via a PostToolUse hook. At its default setting it removed 10.3% of all tool-output tokens (18.1% of the subset it is eligible to touch) across 30 sessions from 30 projects. Not covered by barber's published retention benchmark; read the caveats in contrib/claude_code_hook.py first.
